actions.caption: A RESOLUTION OF THE MAYOR AND VILLAGE COUNCIL OF THE VILLAGE OF PALMETTO BAY, FLORIDA, AUTHORIZING THE EXECUTION OF A CONTRACT WITH NICK MARANO TO SERVE AS THE VILLAGE MANAGER; AND PROVIDING AN EFFECTIVE DATE. (Sponsored by Village Council)

actions.title: Community Rating System consulting, $50,000
actions.notes: Vote from the clerk's Index of Resolutions
actions.caption: A RESOLUTION OF THE MAYOR AND VILLAGE COUNCIL OF THE VILLAGE OF PALMETTO BAY, FLORIDA, RELATING TO COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT AND PLANNING AND ZONING; AUTHORIZING THE SELECTION OF THE CORRADINO GROUP, INC., TO PROVIDE COMMUNITY RATING SYSTEM (CRS) CONSULTING SERVICES TO THE VILLAGE IN THE AMOUNT OF $50,000 PER YEAR; FURTHER AUTHORIZING THE INTERIM VILLAGE MANAGER TO APPROVE A CONTRACT FOR THESE SERVICES FOR THE STATED AMOUNT; AND PROVIDING AN EFFECTIVE DATE. (Sponsored by Administration)
